title: Lock runtime and create the testable Pay Slip scaffold
goal: Create a pinned npm-workspace scaffold whose runtime contract, focused architecture test, lint, typecheck, and Next production build pass.
prerequisites: Duke approved the W0 metadata, exact dependency installation, focused test, lint, typecheck, build, and local commit wave
Next 16.3.3 and Prisma 7.10.0 stable compatibility metadata were retrieved on 2026-09-04
excluded_scope: Credentials, Cloudflare, Gmail, Zalo, iPOS, production data
allowed_actions: Read the approved design and implementation plans
Query npm registry metadata for the bounded W0 dependency set
Install only exact versions declared in W0 package manifests
Run the focused RED/GREEN architecture test, lint, typecheck, and one Next production build
Commit only verified W0 files locally
approval_gates: No dependency outside the declared package manifests without a new preview
No PostgreSQL, Prisma, server, browser, credential, tunnel, integration, or production action
must_pass_gates: The runtime-baseline test fails for the missing web runtime contract before the scaffold is implemented
All dependency versions are exact and package-lock.json is committed
all modified files are inside owned_files
stop_conditions: Any required action needs an unowned write or undeclared package
Any secret, real employee data, or external service is required
Second failure at the same evidence layer or one zero-evidence-delta attempt
expected_artifacts: ADR-0001 with exact versions, official URLs, and retrieval date
One production build receipt in command output

execution_envelope.profile_policy: fast_core with payroll evidence boundaries preserved
